hooks.command: if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then cur=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$cur" != "main" ]; then git fetch -q origin main && git switch -q main && git pull -q --ff-only origin main && [ -n "$cur" ] && git branch -q -D "$cur"; fi; echo "Rama actual: $(git branch --show-current). En este repositorio se trabaja y se sube siempre a main (ver CLAUDE.md)."; fi; exit 0
